column3: “from the midst of ten thousand holy ones” renders “from ten thousands of holy ones”; “flashing lightning” renders a difficult phrase often read “fire of law,” and the meaning is uncertain.
“the people” renders the Hebrew plural “peoples”; the meaning of the last lines is uncertain.
“Nor his men be few” renders “and let his men be a number”; NASB reads the line as a negative.
“them” renders the Hebrew “himself”; “may You be” renders “You will be.”
NASB supplies “Let … belong to”; “godly man” renders “faithful one.”
“by Him” renders “on him”; NASB capitalizes “His shoulders,” reading the LORD as the subject.
“righteous sacrifices” renders “sacrifices of righteousness”; “draw out” renders “suck.”
“provided the first part” renders “saw the choicest”; “with the leaders” supplies “with.” The meaning is uncertain.
“the sea” renders a word meaning “the west” (the sea side).
“favored by his brothers” renders “the favored one of his brothers.”
“leisurely walk” renders a rare word often read as “strength”; the meaning is uncertain.
“the God of Jeshurun” renders “God, O Jeshurun”; “skies” renders “clouds.”
